snippet.title: Cozy Holiday 2 | Official Announcement Trailer! Festive Chaos for Up to 10 Players!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Cozy Holiday 2 on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5574450/Cozy_Holiday_2/

Get ready for the silliest snow day ever! Cozy Holiday 2 is a hilarious multiplayer party game for up to 10 players where holiday spirit means racing through a snowy town, plowing snow, delivering food, and whacking your friends with snow shovels.

Earn enough coins to buy the ultimate Christmas tree first, and then run for your life before up to 9 other players catch up, tag you, and swipe the trophy right out of your hands at the very last second!

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/VQqrmTAh4n  
Join our X: https://x.com/Centurion_Dev
Join our Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CenturionDevelopments
Join our BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/centuriondevelopments.sk
